display.title: Episode 482: Reb Yosef Mokir Shabbos (Shabbos Mevarchim Tammuz)
display.summary_short: Before Shabbos Mevarchim Tammuz, Uncle Yossi explains why we say Tehillim that morning, then tells of Yosef Mokir Shabbos, who found a fortune inside a fish bought in honor of Shabbos.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week before Rosh Chodesh Tammuz. Uncle Yossi explains that Shabbos is the source of blessing for the whole week, as the Zohar and Lecha Dodi say, and that on Shabbos Mevarchim Hashem blesses the entire coming month. He describes the Mi She'asah Nissim prayer, asking Hashem to gather all Jews in the merit of their unity, and urges everyone to come to shul early and say as much Tehillim as they can. After the Hakochainik march, a third-grader visiting from Sydney, Australia says the Shema and tells about Tzivos Hashem there, and everyone gives tzedakah. The story tells of Rabbi Yosef Mokir Shabbos, who bought the biggest fish every week and shared it with the poor, while a stingy rich man, warned by a stargazer that his wealth would go to Rabbi Yosef, turned everything into one diamond and sewed it into his hat. The wind blew the hat into the sea, and the diamond turned up inside the great fish Rabbi Yosef bought for Shabbos. The show ends with candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: Whatever we spend in honor of Shabbos, Shabbos repays in full; and sharing our blessings with others is the way to true wealth.

date.note: 'Next week we begin the new month of Tammuz... this coming Shabbos is Shabbos Mevarchim'; candle lighting 8:07; Rosh Chodesh Tammuz 5751 = 12-13 June 1991; one week after episode 481. A Tuesday.
